description: Phishing, typosquat, scam — is this link safe to click? PAID over x402 inside this tool call (quick $0.01, full $0.05 USDC on Base or Arc): check a URL before you click it. Returns a fixed-schema security assessment — verdict (safe / suspicious / dangerous / unknown), score 0-100, action (allow / review / block / retry), one-sentence summary, top 5 findings, category scores and facts. Quick (quick:true, default): lookalike/typosquat detection, in-house IOC list, page content and brand checks, page-script malware patterns. Full (quick:false): DNS and SSL, domain age (direct WHOIS), brand impersonation, wallet extraction, redirect chain, forms and JS behavior. Repeat scans within 1 hour return the cached result free. Unknown stays unknown: a paid scan is not a security guarantee. Call once without payment to get the x402 PaymentRequired, then call again with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"].
